# Preflight A11y

> Free, browser-only accessibility preflight for DOCX and PPTX course documents. It finds detectable issues, explains fixes, and produces a downloadable report. It is not a compliance certification and does not remediate files.

Canonical: https://huhu954.github.io/preflight-a11y/
Last updated: 2026-10-29
Language: English
Author: independent developer (Weilan Hao)

## What it does

- Parses DOCX and PPTX locally in the browser with JSZip; files are not uploaded.
- Checks document title, language, heading structure, slide titles, alt-text presence and quality signals, table header rows, ambiguous links, text boxes, hidden slides, tiny text, tracked changes, comments, and embedded media that needs captions.
- Produces a 0–100 preflight score, findings grouped by critical/serious/moderate/minor, WCAG 2.1/2.2 references, plain-English impact, fix instructions, and a downloadable standalone HTML report.
- Supports DOCX and PPTX up to 15 MB.

## What it does not do

- It is not a certification, audit opinion, or legal advice.
- It cannot establish WCAG, ADA, EAA, or Section 508 conformance.
- It cannot judge whether alt text is meaningful or verify screen-reader pronunciation/reading order.
- It does not cover PDF.
- It does not remediate or edit the source file.

## Who it is for

- Accessibility consultants and agencies doing a first pass before a manual audit or remediation quote.
- Course teams, instructional designers, and L&D teams preparing DOCX/PPTX course materials.
- Not for confidential student records; use synthetic or client-approved files.

## Commercial status

Free research preview. Payment is not enabled. A $19 per report / $49 for five files price is a test hypothesis, not a validated price. There are no customer testimonials, orders, or revenue claims on this site.
